name: NEONTRIP Supplier Completed Offers Sync v0.1 (INACTIVE DRAFT)

parameters.content: Inactive draft. Regularly asks the Ops app to import completed offers and enrich Sales-Vergabe rows with recent Shopify Admin order data, including statusPageUrl/payment links. Supabase/Ops remains source of truth; Shopify is a reconciliation source; Trello is not read. The Ops endpoint is bounded, idempotent, and authenticated via an internal bearer token from n8n environment variables. If the first Shopify link has the strict impossible signature (historical order plus customer and total mismatch), one privacy-safe internal email is sent to info@neontrip.de. No customer communication or automatic repair is performed.
